title: Azaria the Priest
summary: Raleigh names Azaria the Priest in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Azaria the high Priest, also called Azarias, who reprehended Vzzia for burning incense, not Azaria the King. The one-word title would fold onto ahaziah-of-judah, which already stores the form Azaria, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIII, §. II, sig. 336b–337a
